name: Kōji Counter
tagline: A 12-seat counter in SoHo for omakase roundtables, with a zero-proof pairing that non-drinkers actually like.
bio: I'm Hana. My counter seats 12, which is the right size for a conversation everyone can hear. I serve a short omakase and pour a fermented zero-proof pairing alongside sake for those who want it.
terms: Free to cancel up to 10 days before. Inside 10 days, 50%.
backupPlan: My partner chef Ken runs the counter if I can't; same menu.

experiences.name: Omakase roundtable for 12
experiences.desc: Ten courses at one counter, one conversation. I keep the explanations short.
experiences.allIn: Counter buyout, food, zero-proof pairing, service and tax. Sake pairing $45 a person extra.
experiences.dietary: Pescatarian by nature; a vegetarian omakase with a week's notice.
experiences.access: Counter-height seats; a table setting for anyone who prefers it.
